sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Social Commerce via Short Video Platforms

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Civil Law foundation with Anglo-American corporate law and maritime law influences)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama–European Union Association Agreement (investment and trade pillar)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (AML/CFT framework), as amended; Ley 254 de 2019 (Beneficial Owner Registry and tax transparency rules); Executive Decree implementing Ley 23/2015 and consequential UAF circulars; Law 47 of 2013 on antitrust and anti-corruption protocols; Registro Público resolutions on mandatory UBO filing by resident agents.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of valid passport of each shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport/identity authority of the country of nationality or residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy + Hague Apostille (if issuing state is party), otherwise consular legalization before a Panamanian consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police / criminal records certificate from country of residence of each UBO and legal person's authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent national police or judicial records agency in the country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or equivalent corporate registry extract of any direct corporate shareholder or parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry / Registrar of Companies in the jurisdiction of incorporation of the shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds statement for initial capital contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Relationship bank / financial institution of the UBO or shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Signed by bank + notarized; apostille/consular legalization when required by Panamanian resident agent policy

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney for incorporation (if shareholder acts through an attorney) and signed UBO declaration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction of the shareholder/UBO

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, and authorized signatories against the Panama Financial Analysis Unit (UAF) watch list, the United Nations consolidated sanctions list, OFAC SDN / non-SDN sanctions lists, EU/UK consolidated financial sanctions targets, and the national PEP registry; enhanced due diligence is triggered by PEP status, adverse media, or any sanctions hit; resident agent must retain a source-of-wealth file in compliance with FATF standards.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – Portal de Servicios en Línea (https://www.registropublico.gob.pa)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be in Spanish or in a foreign language written in Latin script; Spanish translation of the corporate name must appear in the charter if the approved name is non-Spanish; names that are phonetically identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered name are refused.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: PANAMÁ (where it implies official state sponsorship; prior ministerial authorization required for regulated tokens)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant may within ten (10) business days file a petition for reconsideration before the Director General of the Registro Público; if denied, an administrative appeal to the same authority's superior chamber must be filed; after exhaustion of administrative remedies, a 'demanda contencioso-administrativa' may be lodged with the Sala Tercera de lo Contencioso Administrativo de la Corte Suprema de Justicia within two (2) months. No automatic extension of the name reservation; a new reservation is required after the 30-day expiration (plus possible one-time renewal where provided by registry internal practice).

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for operational back-office and social-commerce management, but not as the statutory registered office; each S.A. must have a physical Panamanian registered office and licensed resident agent at a law firm incl. service-of-process address; virtual office acceptance is therefore limited to non-statutory correspondence and remote business functions.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated 5–10% first-year probability for a pure TikTok Shop / social-commerce retail trader with no physical inventory or brick-and-mortar store; municipal 'aviso de operación' inspections may occur, but no mandatory physical store is required.)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search and reservation certificate (Registro Público)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff for 'certificado de búsqueda y reserva de nombre'

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of articles of incorporation (escritura matriz)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Public Notary in the Republic of Panama
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial fee per issuance of first instrument copy

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate registration fee for S.A. at the Registro Público
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Section of Mercantile Registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory corporate registration tariff depending on corporate capital

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille/consular legalization of due-diligence bundle (passports, good-standing, bank reference, POA)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Panama (Apostille Section) / Panamanian Consulate(s)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-document apostille fee (approx. USD 50 x 3 docs) plus postal/translation costs where applicable

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Beneficial Owner Registry initial filing (UBO report of S.A.)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Secretaría Nacional de Beneficiarios Finales / Registro Público de Panamá
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Administrative fee for first UBO declaration and tax-transparency filing

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed resident agent service (first calendar year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Panamanian law firm / licensed resident agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for S.A. resident agency fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office physical address at resident agent's office (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Resident agent / law firm office provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for physical corporate address and service-of-process facility

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT KYC file assembly, PEP/sanctions screening and UAO source-of-funds verification
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing compliance due-diligence fee (per UAF-mandated file)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RUC (tax identification) pre-application and municipal 'aviso de operación' pre-clearance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) and Municipality of registered office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory administrative fee for tax registration and municipal notice

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn translation / transliteration compliance if non-Spanish corporate name is adopted (e.g., TikTok Shop brand suffix)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn public translator authorized by the Corte Suprema de Justicia
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing translator tariff per certified translation of charter and name confirmation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley No. 32 de 26 de febrero de 1927 (General Law of Sociedades Anónimas), as amended, Articles 1, 2, 5, 12-18, 46, and 52-70; implemented by the Regulations of the Registro Público, Agreement No. 2 of 19 October 2012.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Dirección General del Registro Público, Sección de Sociedades Mercantiles (Mercantile Registry Section).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución de Sociedad Anónima (notarized public deed of incorporation), alternatively a Pacto Social inscribed in the Mercantile Registry of Panama.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The General Law requires a minimum authorized capital of USD 10,000, but there is no paid-up or escrow account requirement; capital may be subscribed without immediate payment and non-resident ownership is unrestricted.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 1 OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [S.A.]. The undersigned directors, constituting the first board, hereby resolve: (i) to accept the share subscription by the founding shareholders; (ii) to adopt the registered office located in Panama, Republic of Panama, as filed with the Public Registry; (iii) to appoint the President, Vice-President, Secretary and Treasurer named in the deed; (iv) to authorize the Resident Agent to receive service of process and notifications; (v) to open corporate books and bank accounts; and (vi) to ratify the Mercantile Registry inscription. This resolution takes immediate effect and remains in force until lawfully revoked.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Sistema de Reserva de Nombres (online name reservation module) / Ventanilla Única, Ciudad de Panamá.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to three proposed corporate names through the Public Registry's electronic reservation system or in person at the Ventanilla Única. Pay the reservation fee and obtain the official name reservation certificate, valid for thirty days. The name must contain 'Sociedad Anónima' or the abbreviation 'S.A.' and must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered entity.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity, submit a written objection with supporting evidence or select an alternative name; the registry allows immediate re-filing on the same portal without additional penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública de Panamá (licensed Panamanian notary public).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a Panamanian attorney to draft the Escritura Pública de Constitución or Pacto Social. The incorporators and the appointed Resident Agent must appear physically or electronically before the notary to execute the deed. Attach the name reservation certificate and the capital statement. The notary authenticates signatures and issues certified copies for registry filing.
required_dossiers: Drafted incorporation deed or Pacto Social
Passports or cédulas of all incorporators
Resident Agent appointment and acceptance letter
Copy of the Resident Agent's professional license where required
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary returns the draft with observations, correct the bylaws or descriptive clauses and re-execute the deed; no registry penalty is incurred if corrected within the notary's stated cure period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registry Inscription in the Mercantile Section and Payment of Statutory Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Sección de Sociedades Mercantiles.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the notarized deed to the Mercantile Registry Section together with the official fee form. Pay the inscription fee at the registry teller or via the electronic payment gateway. The registry assigns the corporate folio or product number and issues the inscription certificate evidencing legal existence.
required_dossiers: Proof of payment of registry inscription fees
Complete corporate data sheet (corporate purpose, capital structure, officers)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues an 'observación' (query), the applicant has five business days to provide clarifications or amend the deed through a notarial addendum before re-presentation; failure to cure within the term requires a new payment of the reduced re-filing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Ledger Legalization, Share Certificate Issuance and Resident Agent Post-Registration Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Departamento de Registro de Libros, in coordination with the licensed Resident Agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Resident Agent files the opening of the corporate books (share ledger, minutes book, and accounting records) with the Public Registry's book registration department. The registry stamps and initials each volume. Share certificates are prepared, signed by the officers, and delivered to the shareholders.
required_dossiers: Corporate books (share ledger, minutes book, accounting book)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If book legalization is delayed due to incorrect binding or pagination, procure new volumes from a local commercial printer and re-submit; the registry accepts correction of pagination defects without restarting the inscription process.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Aviso de Operación and Municipal Commercial Operation Permit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipio de Panamá - Dirección de Rentas Municipales, in coordination with the Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Aviso de Operación application through the Ventanilla Única de Atención al Inversionista or the Municipality's online portal, indicating ISIC 4791 and e-commerce retail via short-video platform. Obtain the municipal operating permit and, if applicable, complete the RUC pre-registration with the Dirección General de Ingresos. Submit the physical premises clearance including lease or title documentation and the fire safety certificate.
required_dossiers: RUC application or pre-registration where available
Lease contract or title deed for the registered office or warehouse
Fire safety inspection report from the Fire Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality requires zoning or use-of-soil certification, submit the certificate of occupancy and pay the applicable municipal fee; an administrative appeal may be filed with the Alcalde of Panama City for contested denials.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) - Dirección General de Empresas; municipal licensing through the Municipio de Panamá, Dirección de Rentas Municipales.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación (Notice of Operation) / Municipal Commercial License for ISIC 4791 social-commerce retail via short-video platforms; no separate industrial manufacturing permit is required for pure e-commerce retail.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) - Dirección de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Registration only under Decreto No. 123-2011 and Resolution DG 02-2014 for retail and e-commerce activities; a Category I Environmental Impact Study may be triggered if warehousing or storage facilities exceed established built-area thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater discharge or significant VOC emissions are generated by the retail activity; sanitary wastewater must comply with the national water quality criteria and municipal sewer discharge regulations; packaging and solid waste must be managed under Ley No. 33 de 2018 (Integrated Waste Management) and the National Waste Management Policy.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá (fire load and extinguisher inspection); structural load inspection certificate issued by a licensed engineer and accepted by the Municipality; workplace occupational health clearance from the Ministerio de Salud (MINSA) where employees are physically present; compliance with workplace risk prevention rules of the Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF); official electronic portal: Sede Electrónica DGI / 'e-Tax 2.0' at www.dgi.gob.pa with authorized notaries and certified public accountants acting as registered intermediaries.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign investors must: (1) incorporate a Sociedad Anónima via notary and register with the Registro Público; (2) appoint a resident agent (agente residente) and legal representative; (3) obtain the municipal Aviso de Operación or business license; (4) file the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes) application with DGI, attaching certified copy of the public deed, appointment of directors, identity documents, and evidence of the registered office; (5) obtain the digital signature credential and RUC certificate; (6) activate the e-Tax account for electronic filing of income tax, ITBMS, and dividend tax returns. The entire process takes 5-10 business days; non-resident shareholders are permitted without Panamanian tax residency implications.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Territorial_Scope. A Panama S.A. is an entity-level taxpayer under the Impuesto Sobre la Renta (ISR) but is taxed only on Panama-source income at the headline corporate rate of 25%; foreign-source income is generally outside the taxable base provided the taxpayer maintains adequate substance and the income does not qualify as Panama-source under the Código Fiscal. Dividend distributions are subject to the 10% dividend tax (or 5% for dividends paid out of taxed profits) and a 4% complementary tax on dividends from non-taxed profits. Pass-through treatment is not available for S.A. entities; the entity classification follows the corporate form and cannot be elected away.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama does not operate a US-style 'check-the-box' entity classification regime. An S.A. is mandatorily taxed as a corporation. Available statutory elections and regimes include: (a) the Multinational Headquarters (SEM) regime under Law 41/2007 granting significant ISR and ITBMS exemptions for qualifying regional headquarters; (b) special economic zones such as Panama Pacifico and the City of Knowledge that substitute local taxes for zone-specific fees; (c) optional accrual vs. cash accounting for small taxpayers under DGI conditions; (d) the simplified 'pequeño contribuyente' regime, although only natural persons below the income cap may use it; and (e) group assessment/consolidation is not generally available. Hybrid mismatch elections are not recognized; Panama's income tax law follows a strict territorial source rule rather than an international classification mechanism.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS - Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (VAT-style tax on the transfer of movable goods and services). The system is a destination-based consumption tax with credit mechanism for registered taxpayers.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general turnover threshold for ITBMS; any S.A. carrying out taxable acts (sales of goods, rendering of services, or imports) in Panama must register with the DGI before commencing operations, irrespective of revenue volume. An optional simplified regime exists for natural persons with gross annual income at or below B/.36,000 (equivalent to USD 36,000), taxed at 2% on gross receipts; this option is not available to Sociedad Anónima corporations. For the TikTok Shop retail scope, the commercial platform operator and the Panamanian seller entity are each independently subject to ITBMS registration if they perform taxable supplies in Panama; cross-border digital platform sales to Panamanian consumers are subject to withholding at the payment gateway level.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing ('Facturación Electrónica') is phased in by DGI for all RUC holders, with large taxpayers already obligated. Each invoice must be generated as structured XML or JSON, digitally signed using the taxpayer's cryptographic certificate, and transmitted in real time to the DGI e-Tax platform for automated validation and acceptance/rejection response (Resultado de Aceptación y Rechazo). Accepted invoices receive a fiscal authorization code and a QR code that must be printed or displayed. ERP application-to-application (API) integration is required for high-volume sellers such as e-commerce and social commerce operators; fiscal printers remain accepted for physical point-of-sale equivalence. Delivery notes, credit notes, debit notes, and export invoices must all flow through the same electronic clearance infrastructure.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A registered ITBMS taxpayer may apply the 0% rate to: (a) physical exports of goods when the merchandise leaves Panamanian customs territory under a valid customs export declaration; (b) services rendered to non-resident clients when the services are executed, used, or exploited entirely abroad, including digital services and platform advertisements sold to foreign beneficiaries; and (c) supplies to operators of Panama Pacifico and SEM-licensed entities where applicable. The zero-rating is a technical exemption, not an input credit refund mechanism; the exporter must segregate input ITBMS attributable to export sales, claim related input credits proportionally, and recover net credits either by offset against output ITBMS or by filing a refund application with DGI. For TikTok Shop retail, each consumer sale delivered to a foreign address must be supported by proof of export, and sales into Panama are taxable at 7%; the platform's marketplace facilitator obligations are governed by DGI criteria on deemed ITBMS registration for digital platforms.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: DUA - Declaración Única Aduanera (electronic customs export declaration endorsed by the Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas de Panamá with date and exit port),
Transport document: Bill of Lading (maritime), Air Waybill (air), or Carta de Porte/CMR (land), evidencing physical exit of goods from Panama, and

Commercial zero-rated invoice electronically accepted by DGI, plus the SWIFT MT103/MT202 payment confirmation from a Panamanian bank or the inward remittance certificate (Certificado de Ingreso de Divisas) issued by the receiving local bank showing the export proceeds credited to the seller's Panamanian account; supplementary packing lists and insurance certificates are recommended for audit defense.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI conducts targeted audits of export zero-rating claims by cross-checking the electronic customs SIS system, banking records, the e-Tax invoice clearance feed, and carrier manifests. If the export documentation bundle is incomplete, untimely, or inconsistent, DGI retroactively recharacterizes the sale as a taxable domestic supply and assesses the 7% ITBMS with monthly interest and surcharges, and fines ranging from 50% to 200% of the omitted tax depending on the degree of fault. Deliberate fabrication of export documents or false invoicing constitutes criminal tax fraud (defraudación fiscal) under the Código Penal, punishable by imprisonment, disqualification from acting as a RUC holder, and publication of the sanction; the statute of limitations for assessment is generally three years, extended to six years where returns are omitted or false, with no limitation period for fraudulent documents in aggravated cases. Repatriation within the 180-day reference period is the DGI's administrative benchmark; longer terms require documented open-account commercial terms and may attract TP and fictive-benefit scrutiny.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: No central bank or dedicated foreign-exchange administration exists in Panama. The Republic operates under full US dollarization; the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panama (SBP) supervises and regulates all banking licensees, while Banco Nacional de Panama acts solely as fiscal agent for government accounts. No authority issues Balboa paper currency or administers exchange controls.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility without capital controls. USD is legal tender and the Balboa (PAB) is a nominal 1:1 accounting unit minted only as coins. Current-account and capital-account flows, including TikTok Shop sales revenue and profit remittances, may be moved freely in USD without central bank approval. Remittance of dividends is subject only to the 10% dividend withholding tax and standard bank AML/CFT source-of-funds verification under Law 23 of 2015. No foreign-exchange authorization or documentary clearance is required.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None applicable. Panama imposes no export proceeds surrender, compulsory conversion, repatriation timeline, or settlement-in-local-currency obligation on e-commerce exporters. The only compliance layer is commercial: Panamanian banks must preserve transaction records and can request evidence (order ledgers, payout statements, supplier invoices) for anti-money-laundering reporting under Law 23 of 2015 and SBP due-diligence rules.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: Medium-High as treasury overlay, but not as primary settlement venue. Offshore digital EMIs (Wise B2B, Airwallex, Payoneer) may open USD accounts through US/EU/UK partner banks; however, they are not SBP-licensed banks and cannot provide a Panamanian clearing branch. Their USD rails settle via US ACH/Fedwire and are legally acceptable for collection of TikTok Shop payouts provided the operating S.A. maintains a corresponding SBP-supervised Panamanian bank account for DGI tax payments, statutory record retention, and AML audit trail. Wise's Panama-residency product eligibility must be verified at onboarding; if unavailable, direct TikTok Seller payout to a Panamanian bank account is the compliant fallback.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory rule mandates physical presence, but dominant market practice requires an initial in-person interview at the local branch for at least one director or a formally appointed attorney-in-fact, together with the Registered Agent certifying corporate validity. Remote onboarding is possible at select banks (e.g., certain units of BAC Credomatic and Multibank) using apostilled incorporation documents, certified board resolutions, notarized signature cards, and enhanced video verification, yet most tier-1 banks still condition final account activation on a first-visit signatory appointment executed before a Panamanian Notary Public.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity marketplace payouts from TikTok (Singapore/USA) not backed by a formal written commerce agreement.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed TikTok Shop Seller Agreement; platform payout statements; order-level transaction history; standard terms with TikTok Pte. Ltd.; DGI ITBMS registration; Aviso de Operacion and Patente Municipal.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sociedad Anonima with offshore-only directors and no commercial premises in Panama.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Lease or co-working agreement with utility bill; municipal Patente certificate; registered office confirmation from the Resident Agent; director identification and valid passports; local compliance officer appointment (Oficial de Cumplimiento).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ownership held by a Private Interest Foundation (PIF) or use of immobilized bearer shares obscuring beneficial owners.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: PIF foundation charter and BOD minutes; certified register of beneficial owners filed per Law 70 of 2019 (RUEF); legal opinion confirming ultimate beneficial ownership; compliance declarations under Law 23 of 2015 and SBP due-diligence standards.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transaction thresholds triggered (single deposits/exports above USD 10,000 or frequent third-country receivables) creating SAR exposure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written AML/CFT manual; customer risk profile (tier: Low-Risk Standard); transaction monitoring policy; source-of-funds affidavits; audited financial historicals; mapping of TikTok payout cycles to bank statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unlicensed retail activity where the entity cannot evidence its RUC (taxpayer identification) and ITBMS standing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: DGI RUC certificate; ITBMS registration (7% transfer tax); formatted sales invoices (factura) series; point-of-sale/live-commerce order ledger; annual income tax returns under Panama's territorial taxation regime.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Blended routing permitted. Shareholder capital injections: SWIFT MT103 from the beneficial owner's bank to the S.A.'s Panamanian account, reference 'Aporte de capital social - Sociedad Anonima', supported by board resolution approving share issuance and a capital contribution certificate; no minimum capital is required, so an initial injection of USD 5,000-10,000 into the operational account is recommended to evidence substance. Operating revenue: TikTok Shop payouts via direct SWIFT MT103 from TikTok Pte. Ltd. (Singapore) or TikTok LLC (USA), or via Wise B2B ACH/USD rails, referencing 'Retail e-commerce revenue settlement - social commerce live sales'. No exchange-control authorization is required, but receiving banks apply automatic AML monitoring for values above USD 10,000 and may hold clearing pending digital copy of the seller agreement and payout statement.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Settlement rails: (1) SWIFT MT103 for direct supplier payments and MT202 COV for correspondent cover; (2) Commercial Letters of Credit (UCP 600) with advising bank confirmation for inventory imports from Asia; (3) local ACH/direct credits via Panama's national clearinghouse for domestic vendor payouts; (4) interbank USD leg cleared via US correspondents (Fedwire/CHIPS). All outbound invoices should reference the ITBMS and RUC, and beneficiary identifiers must match KYB records to avoid funds recall.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forwards in EUR/USD, GBP/USD, or CNY/USD executed with SBP-licensed Panamanian banks or their global counterparts
Cross-currency swaps (ISDA 2002 Master Agreement) to hedge USD/CNY and USD/SGD exposure from TikTok and supplier flows
Plain-vanilla FX options and collars with licensed counterparties
Currency clauses in commercial import contracts with Chinese suppliers (natural hedge via USD invoicing)

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are structurally unavailable in PAB/USD due to the 1:1 fixed peg and full dollarization; any NDF requirement must be booked offshore in a third-country currency pair (e.g., USD/CNY) under SBP-compliant documentation

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate franchise tax (Impuesto Anual de Sociedades)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payable each calendar year on or before 30 June, within the DGI annual corporate tax window.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory late-payment surcharge plus monthly interest under the Panamanian Tax Code; non-payment for two consecutive annual cycles permits the registrant to be administratively struck off and dissolved by the Registro Público.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual registry report (Informe Anual) to the Public Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Personas Jurídicas
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary-based; due within the calendar window assigned by the Registro Público, generally within three months after the corporate anniversary or the published DGI/Registry schedule for the entity.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing tariffs and loss of good standing; two consecutive unfiled annual reports can trigger suspension, and continued default leads to administrative strike-off/cancellation of the Panamanian S.A.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual income tax return (Declaración de Renta de Personas Jurídicas, Form 106)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March following the 31 December fiscal year-end; for a company with a different fiscal year, within three months after the fiscal year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fines, statutory interest and surcharges under the Tax Code; a remote TikTok Shop business with no Panama-source income must still file a zero return when tax-registered, and omission can expose the entity and its resident agent to fines up to USD 10,000.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-ownership confirmation (UBO / beneficiario final annual confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Público de Panamá / AML Beneficiary-Ownership Module under Law 23 of 2015
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submitted with the annual registry report and updated within 30 days of any share transfer or change in ultimate beneficial control.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to USD 10,000 per violation under AML Law 23 of 2015, possible suspension of corporate activity, and rejection or strike-off of registry filings.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory independent audit for a private Panama S.A. deriving income solely from remote TikTok Shop retail and not conducting licensed financial, insurance, securities or other regulated public-interest activities. Independent audit is triggered if the S.A. is a licensed financial institution, is registered with the securities authority, is selected by the DGI for audit, or operates in Panama with annual gross receipts above the DGI audit threshold, currently around USD 1,500,000.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Panama, with IFRS for SMEs available for private companies; accounting income is reconciled to the Panamanian Territorial Tax Code for income tax return preparation.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The S.A. must maintain at its registered office a current legal-ownership and beneficial-ownership register. The resident agent is required to identify, verify and retain KYC/AML documentation for the ultimate beneficial owner. Every share transfer must be approved by the board, recorded in the share ledger, and the resident agent must update the UBO register and file the annual beneficial-ownership confirmation within the statutory window. The confirmation is integrated with the annual registry report and must be signed by the resident agent and the directors.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book (shareholders' and board meeting minutes)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350–1,200 per year (resident agent and registered office)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500–4,500 per certified audit engagement for a remote e-commerce S.A.; zero if audit is not triggered

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial taxation: only income sourced in Panama is subject to the Impuesto sobre la Renta (Fiscal Code Art. 694). Genuine foreign-source revenue (sales contracted, delivered and paid outside Panama with full documentary trace) is excluded from the taxable base. No net-wealth tax, no branch remittance tax, no capital gains tax on foreign securities. For a standard Panama S.A. engaged in TikTok Shop commercial activity, only statutory deductions apply (cost of goods, logistics, platform commissions, payment-processing fees, payroll and local expenses). No e-commerce-specific tax holiday exists.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 745 - Declaración de Renta Anual de Personas Jurídicas; filed electronically via the DGI 'e-Renta' portal (T@P-40 successor) at www.dgi.gob.pa.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Three months after the fiscal year-end. For a calendar-year taxpayer, due on or before March 31 of the following year. No automatic extension of the filing deadline; quarterly advance payments (Form 746) remain separately due.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All gross revenue from the TikTok Shop retail/live-commerce activity sourced in Panama.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The S.A. is a Panamanian tax resident, so it must declare; include the full TikTok Shop payout even if collected through the Wise B2B wallet. Segregate foreign-source revenue only where the contract, delivery and payment all occur abroad and the export evidence is retained.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 2 - Ingresos exentos / no gravables (exempt or foreign-source income)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Revenue excluded under the territorial rule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only amounts supported by export documentation, foreign buyer contracts and foreign payout statements; revenue from goods delivered to Panamanian buyers must never be reported in this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 3 - Costos y gastos deducibles (deductible costs and expenses)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: COGS, TikTok platform fees, influencer/content costs, logistics, payment-processor charges, local wages and rent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany payments to related content studios or group service providers require arm's-length invoices and a transfer pricing study; content-license fees paid abroad are subject to 12.5% royalty withholding. Deduct only expenses substantiated by valid invoices and bank records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 4 - Ingreso neto gravable (net taxable income)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Standard computation; a nil or loss result should be consistent with the 5-year carryforward schedule.
No alternative minimum tax; no foreign tax credit is available for foreign-source excluded income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 6 - Pagos anticipados y retenciones (advance payments and withholdings)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits for quarterly Form 746 advances and any third-party withholdings.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: First-year S.A. normally has no advance credits; attach the WHT certificates issued by intermediaries/marketplaces if any.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 7 - Cuota tributaria neta (net tax payable)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Balance due must be paid by bank Pago Electrónico concurrently with the return no later than March 31.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing fine between B/.50 and B/.10,000 depending on gross income (Fiscal Code Art. 762); 2% monthly default interest on any unpaid tax; 10% surcharge for voluntary late correction or 25% after formal DGI notice, plus inflationary adjustment of the tax base; repeat violations may trigger closure of the commercial premises and criminal referral.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 745-A - Anexo/Informe de Precios de Transferencia (Ley 45 de 2017); embedded in the annual DGI e-Renta filing.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Fiscal year-end; due on the same date as Form 745 (March 31 following a December 31 year-end).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section R - Operaciones con partes relacionadas
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Itemized related-party transactions, including payments to foreign content studios, group commissions and management fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List each transaction separately; companies controlled by the non-resident beneficial owner, the UBO's family vehicles or the content supplier in Singapore/Hong Kong are all related parties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section M - Método de precios de transferencia aplicado
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selection of the OECD arm's-length method applied to each material transaction.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Retain the full Local File, comparables and intercompany agreements; the method declared must match the retained study. If total revenue is below the B/.3 million threshold, answer 'not subject' but still disclose transactions over B/.1 million.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-submission or false submission of the TP annex: fine up to B/.100,000, plus the 200% surcharge on any tax adjustment and 2% monthly interest; documentation defects also expose directors to criminal liability where deliberate mispricing is inferred.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 746 - Declaración de Pago Anticipado del ISR; filed electronically in the DGI e-Renta system.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Four equal installments of 25% each, due on the 15th day of June, September, December and March of the fiscal year, based on the income tax paid in the immediately preceding year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer RUC and the fiscal year to which the advance applies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A newly incorporated S.A. is exempt from advance payments during its first operating year; the first advances begin in the second year using the prior year's final tax paid.
Pay by ACH in USD/B/.; missed installments accrue 2% monthly interest and are not excused by the absence of cash distributions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late or missing advance payments: 2% monthly interest, 10%-25% surcharges on the difference, embargo of the bank account (including Wise B2B) and restriction of the RUC, which blocks payment rails.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 5% on dividends paid out of profits already subject to the 25% corporate income tax (Fiscal Code Art. 733); 10% on distributions made out of exempt or foreign-source profits and on dividends the payer cannot substantiate as taxed. Dividend distributions by a standard S.A. are additionally preceded by the 1.4% 'advance dividend tax' mechanism only where the company elects the optional accelerated payment regime; the standard rule is 5%/10% at the moment of constructive distribution.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Panama's double-tax agreements in force include treaties with Mexico, Singapore, South Korea and the Dominican Republic, among others. To invoke a DTA reduction, the non-resident shareholder must obtain a tax residence certificate (TRC) from its home tax authority, present it to the Panamanian withholding agent, and the payer must apply the treaty rate on the monthly withholding return (Form 733). Excess WHT is recovered only through the DGI refund procedure ('devolución') attaching the TRC, dividend minutes, proof of paying-agent withholding and the treaty LOB clause analysis. If the UBO is resident in a non-treaty jurisdiction, the 5%/10% statutory WHT applies without relief.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties (IP/content licensing, software and trademark rights): statutory Panama-source WHT of 12.5% (Art. 733 Fiscal Code); DTA rates commonly 10% (e.g., Mexico, South Korea). Interest on loans from non-resident lenders: statutory 5%; interest paid to Panama-licensed banks or on securities registered with the SMV is exempt; treaty-resident creditors may obtain a lower rate only with TRC and substantive ownership proof.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: B/.3,000,000 (~USD 3,000,000) of annual gross revenue triggers the mandatory TP Local File and the 745-A annex; intra-group transactions (e.g., content fees, commissions, license payments) exceeding B/.1,000,000 in the fiscal year also require full documentation. A Master File is required for multinational groups with consolidated revenue above B/.50,000,000; the Country-by-Country Report applies to groups with consolidated revenue of USD 750,000,000 (Ley 45 de 2017 and Reg. 201-7108).
approved_arm_length_methodologies: Any other method accepted by the DGI under OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines as an arm's-length fallback
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama's Economic Substance Regime (Law 254 of 2020, implemented by Executive Decree and DGI Resolution) applies to relevant entities carrying on relevant activities. A TikTok Shop retail S.A. performing distribution, online retail and service-center functions is classified as a 'distribution and service center' relevant activity. It must demonstrate: (i) direction and management in Panama; (ii) adequate local premises and qualified employees; (iii) core income-generating activities performed within Panamanian territory; and (iv) an annual sworn substance report filed via the SUIRE platform. Failure to comply carries fines from B/.10,000 up to B/.1,000,000 and publication on the DGI non-cooperative list; persistence of a pure shell structure also justifies the DGI's re-characterization of the territorial tax exclusion and exposure to the full 25% tax on the entire cross-border profit.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentionally omitting from Form 745 Panamanian-source TikTok Shop live-commerce revenue collected via TikTok Shop Payout or the Wise B2B wallet; misclassifying local sales as 'foreign-source' to exploit the territorial rule; destroying payout statements; using fake cost invoices to reduce the taxable base.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fiscal Code Arts. 762-763: surcharge of 200% of the omitted tax plus 2% monthly interest and inflationary adjustment of the base. Penal Code Art. 278-A (Law 49 of 2019): imprisonment of 2-5 years, aggravated to 5-10 years where the amount defrauded exceeds B/.100,000 or false documents are used; fine equal to the amount evaded; corporate fine between B/.100,000 and B/.1,000,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the legal representative who sign or approve a false return face direct criminal conviction, precautionary travel bans, attachment of personal assets, disqualification from acting as administrators, and personal civil restitution of the omitted tax jointly with the company under veil-piercing principles.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the S.A. as a nominee structure without physical office, local management, employees or recorded core activity in Panama, while the TikTok retail operation is directed remotely by the UBO; filing the SUIRE substance report with a false 'no relevant activity' declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Law 254 of 2020: B/.10,000-B/.100,000 for late or incomplete filing; false declaration B/.20,000-B/.100,000; failure to meet the substance test B/.100,000-B/.1,000,000; cancellation of the corporate registration and publication on the EU/OECD blacklist for shell-company activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The Resident Agent and each director are jointly and severally exposed to the fines; the Penal Code criminalizes the use of fictitious companies (sociedad ficticia) with imprisonment; travel bans and the suspension of professional licences apply while the proceedings are pending.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Funnelling TikTok Shop sales proceeds through the Wise B2B wallet and offshore accounts of related nominees; performing rapid round-trip transfers inconsistent with the documented retail profile; failure to maintain the beneficial-ownership registry (Registro de Accionistas/UBO) or to report suspicious transactions under Law 23 of 2015.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fine of B/.10,000 to B/.1,000,000 under Law 23 of 2015; money-laundering offense under the Penal Code (Arts. 254 et seq.): imprisonment of 5-10 years and fines up to B/.5,000,000 for the legal entity; in rem forfeiture/extinción de dominio over the proceeds and the connected bank accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve or implement the transfers are personally subject to money-laundering prosecution, extradition within the Inter-American mutual-assistance framework, travel bans, freezing of personal assets, and no corporate veil protection for criminal conduct.
